newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Thursday that around 3,600 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Wednesday, with prices steady to firmer.

Around 1,800 head were sold through Presidio, Texas, at steady prices for feeder steers and steer calves. "Trade and demand was moderate. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said.
Prices for 300-400 lb head were between 68-78 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head they were between 64-68 cents/lb.

Through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 1,800 steer calves and yearlings sold firm to $1.00/lb higher compared to last week. "Active trade, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-600 lb," USDA added.
For head weighing 300-400 lb, prices were 68-78 cents/lb for 400-500 lb head they were 64-68 cents/lb and for 500-600 lb head they were 64 cents/lb.
